title: Wizards take Tre Johnson (No. 6) and Will Riley (No. 21) in first round of 2025 NBA Draft - NewsBreak
text: WASHINGTON (DC News Now) – The first round of the 2025 NBA draft is underway Wednesday night from Brooklyn, New York. The Washington Wizards made two selections in the first round at No. 6 and No. 21 overall. With the sixth overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft, the Washington Wizards selected Tre Johnson out of Texas. In his freshman year with the Longhorns, the 19-year-old averaged 19.9 points per game while shooting 42.7% from the field and 39.7% from the three-point line in 33 games during the 2024-25 season, where he was also the 6th freshman in SEC history to lead the conference in scoring. Johnson was named the 2024-25 SEC freshman of the year by coaches and the newcomer of the year by the media. With the 21st overall pick in the 2025 NBA Draft, the Washington Wizards selected forward Will Riley out of Illinois. During his freshman year with the Fighting Illini, Riley averaged 12.6 points per game while shooting 43.2% from the field and 32.6% from the three-point line. Riley was also named the 2024-25 Big Ten sixth man of the year. While the Wizards were on the clock during their second pick in the first round, they made a trade with the Utah Jazz, exchanging their 18th pick for the 21st overall pick and the 43rd overall pick, along with two second-round picks (2031, 2032.) The 2025 NBA draft will continue Thursday with the second round, where the Wizards plan to make the 43rd overall selection.
